visual_synopsis: A bespectacled doctor in a white coat takes a phone call at his desk, then sits through a long consultation with a shaggy-haired, mustachioed patient in a purple tracksuit jacket over a red-checked shirt, the two shot in alternating close-ups as the patient gestures and explains himself. In the last stretch the patient has shed the jacket and stands against a plain white wall still talking and jabbing his finger, the whole sketch carried entirely by dialogue rather than action.
